search.title: Search
search.similarHint: Nothing matched exactly, so these are the closest words.
search.similarHintSynced: Nothing synced so far matched exactly, so these are the closest words.
search.filtered: filtered — press the facet again to clear
search.noOperators: from: and in: are not filters here. Narrow the results with From and Folder beside them.
search.eggHint: The design direction ohmail is built in — shadow-sculpted white.
search.junkScope: Search does not reach your mail server's own {folder} folder — ohmail does not mirror it.
search.junkScopeUnnamed: Search does not reach your mail server's own junk folder — ohmail does not mirror it.
search.partReach: A part inside a word is looked for in subjects, senders, recipients and attachment names, not in the message text.
search.emptyAddressScopes: An address is its own search — everything {address} sent, or anything from or to them.
search.scopeIndexing: Still reading your recent mail — more results will appear.
search.scopeWhole: Searched your whole mailbox — {total, plural, =0 {nothing matched} other {# matched}}
search.scopeWholeAtLeast: Searched your whole mailbox — at least {total, number} matched
search.scopeWholeAbout: Searched your whole mailbox — about {total, number} matched
search.scopeSynced: Searched the mail synced so far — {total, plural, =0 {nothing matched} other {# matched}}
search.scopeSyncedAtLeast: Searched the mail synced so far — at least {total, number} matched
search.scopeSyncedAbout: Searched the mail synced so far — about {total, number} matched
search.syncing: The rest of your mail has not synced yet.
search.scopeMirror: Search covers the mail on this computer while ohmail Cloud is unreachable — {total, plural, =0 {nothing matched} other {# matched}}
search.scopeMirrorAtLeast: Search covers the mail on this computer while ohmail Cloud is unreachable — at least {total, number} matched
search.scopeMirrorAbout: Search covers the mail on this computer while ohmail Cloud is unreachable — about {total, number} matched
search.scopeWholeNear: Searched your whole mailbox — {total, number} with a close word
search.scopeWholeNearAtLeast: Searched your whole mailbox — at least {total, number} with a close word
search.scopeSyncedNear: Searched the mail synced so far — {total, number} with a close word
search.scopeSyncedNearAtLeast: Searched the mail synced so far — at least {total, number} with a close word
search.scopeMirrorNear: Search covers the mail on this computer while ohmail Cloud is unreachable — {total, number} with a close word
search.scopeMirrorNearAtLeast: Search covers the mail on this computer while ohmail Cloud is unreachable — at least {total, number} with a close word
search.scopeDepth: A long message is searched in its first 65,536 characters.
search.scopeUnanswered: Your server did not answer — showing the recent mail this device holds.
search.scopeFailed: Your server could not run this search — showing the recent mail this device holds.
search.indexing: Older mail is still being indexed — {percent} % done.
search.bounded: Showing the {count} best matches — sort by date to walk them all.
search.keyOpen: Open the result where it lives
search.keyClose: Clear the search — again to leave
search.addressArchive: {count, plural, one {1 in your whole mailbox} other {# in your whole mailbox}}
search.addressArchiveBySender: {count, plural, one {1 in your whole mailbox (by sender)} other {# in your whole mailbox (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveSynced: {count, plural, one {1 in the mail synced so far} other {# in the mail synced so far}}
search.addressArchiveAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in your whole mailbox}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderSynced: {count, plural, one {1 in the mail synced so far (by sender)} other {# in the mail synced so far (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in your whole mailbox (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveSyncedAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in the mail synced so far}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderSyncedAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in the mail synced so far (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderWhy: Your whole mailbox is searched by sender only, so this number counts the mail this address sent. Older mail sent to it is not counted yet.
search.addressArchiveNoRecipients: your whole mailbox cannot be searched by recipient yet
search.addressArchiveNoRecipientsWhy: This list is the recent mail sent to this address. Older mail sent to it cannot be listed yet.
search.addressOffline: ohmail Cloud can't be reached — showing the mail on this computer.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.foot: Keys apply where they are listed. Any key closes this.
shortcuts.replyAll: Reply to everyone on the message
shortcuts.answerLater: Queue it for the Reply Run
shortcuts.park: Park it (out of the way, still here)
shortcuts.layoutSame: The two layouts look the same at this window width.
shortcuts.needsCursor: Select a message first — ↑/↓ or click a row
